fields.why:
The Decant Return Pond supplies both the Pilgan Plant process water ponds and the 5 ML Turkey Nest. The transfer pumps currently operate in manual mode only. During periods of high demand, the Decant Return Pond has reduced to approximately 20% capacity, creating a risk of insufficient raw water supply for mining operations.
A review of the existing control strategy identified an opportunity to improve transfer reliability and water availability through automatic level-based pump control while retaining the existing manual operating mode.
fields.design:
References:
- PIL-20000-PID-PR-369 – AREA 322 TAILINGS DECANT RETURN DAM - PIPING AND INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM – Rev 1
- PIL-20000-PID-PR-727 – PILGAN - 27200 - PROCESS WATER - P&ID SHEET 1 OF 3 (FLOTATION PW PONDS & PUMPS) – Rev 4
- PIL-36105-PID-PR-508 – RAW WATER SUPPLY AREA 361 PIPING AND INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM – Rev 1

Overview:
The following overview describes the intended operational behaviour, while the detailed control tables provide the implementation requirements and traceability to field devices and P&IDs. The general automation philosophy of this PCSCR is to automatically start and stop transfer pumps based on source and destination water levels, with independent source level setpoints providing prioritisation of destination water supply requirements, as shown in the following diagram.
[Image in form – see source document]

PLC Changes:
The proposed PLC changes are grouped into Inputs, Control and Outputs in the following table to improve traceability between field devices, the control strategy and PLC implementation.

INPUTS:
- 272-LT-0812 Process Water Pond Level Transmitter – Destination level used for automatic transfer control by 322-PU-794. Flow can be controlled by 272-XV-4015. (Existing Level Transmitter)
- 272-LT-3347 HMS Process Water Pond Level Transmitter – Destination level used for automatic transfer control by 322-PU-794. Flow can be controlled by 272-XV-4014. (Existing Level Transmitter)
- 322-LT-6110 Decant Return Pond Level Transmitter – Source level used for automatic transfer control by 322-PU-794 and 322-PU-796. (Existing Level Transmitter)
- 364-PN-101-LT01 5 ML Turkey Nest Level Transmitter – Destination level used for automatic transfer control by 322-PU-796. (Existing Level Transmitter)

CONTROL:
- 322-PU-794 Decant Dam Return Water Pump 1 (Duty Pump) – Automatic operation added. Duty pump supplying Pilgan Plant process water ponds.
 Auto Start: Decant Return Pond 322-LT-6110 ≥ 70% AND 322-LT-6110 Healthy AND ((272-XV-4015 Open Command Active AND PWP 272-LT-0812 Healthy) OR (272-XV-4014 Open Command Active AND HMS PWP 272-LT-3347 Healthy))
 Auto Stop: 322-LT-6110 ≤ 65% OR 322-LT-6110 Not Healthy OR ((272-XV-4015 Close Command Active OR PWP 272-LT-0812 Not Healthy) AND (272-XV-4014 Close Command Active OR HMS PWP 272-LT-3347 Not Healthy))
 Independent source level setpoints provide prioritisation of Pilgan Plant process water supply over the 5 ML Turkey Nest. (Existing pump add auto and new logic.)
- 322-PU-795 Decant Dam Return Water Pump 2 (Standby Pump) – Automatic operation added. Common standby pump. Operator selectable between 322-PU-794 and 322-PU-796 control strategies. Follows selected duty pump Auto control strategy. Performs automatic valve alignment for selected destination. (Existing pump add auto and new logic.)
- 322-PU-796 Decant Dam Return Water Pump 3 (Duty Pump) – Automatic operation added. Duty pump supplying 5 ML Turkey Nest.
 Auto Start: 322-LT-6110 ≥ 85% AND 322-LT-6110 Healthy AND 5ML TN 364-PN-101-LT01 ≤ 70% AND 364-PN-101-LT01 Healthy
 Auto Stop: 322-LT-6110 ≤ 80% OR 322-LT-6110 Not Healthy OR 364-PN-101-LT01 ≥ 90% OR 364-PN-101-LT01 Not Healthy
 Independent source level setpoints provide prioritisation of Pilgan Plant process water supply over the 5 ML Turkey Nest. (Existing pump add auto and new logic.)
- 322-PU-797 NLO Decant Dam Return Water Pump – No changes proposed to existing setup. (Existing – No Changes.)

OUTPUTS:
- 322-XV-6126 Decant Return Water Pump 2 To Pilgan Valve – Automatic operation added. Open when 322-PU-795 is assigned as standby to 322-PU-794. Close when 322-PU-795 is assigned as standby to 322-PU-796. (Enable Auto mode and new logic.)
- 322-XV-6127 Decant Return Water Pump 2 to 5 ML Valve – Automatic operation added. Open when 322-PU-795 is assigned as standby to 322-PU-796. Close when 322-PU-795 is assigned as standby to 322-PU-794. (Enable Auto mode and new logic.)
- 272-XV-4014 Decant Return to HMS PW Pond Valve – Automatic operation added. Type 1 solenoid valve with no feedback. Open: 272-LT-3347 ≤ Start Transfer (L) AND 272-LT-3347 Healthy. Close: 272-LT-3347 ≥ Stop Transfer (H) OR 272-LT-3347 Not Healthy. (Enable Auto mode and new logic.)
- 272-XV-4015 Decant Return to Flotation PW Pond Valve – Automatic operation added. Type 1 solenoid valve with no feedback. Open: 272-LT-0812 ≤ Start Transfer (L) AND 272-LT-0812 Healthy. Close: 272-LT-0812 ≥ Stop Transfer (H) OR 272-LT-0812 Not Healthy. (Enable Auto mode and new logic.)

Notes:
- Existing equipment protection functions, trips and process interlocks shall remain operational unless otherwise modified by this PCSCR.
- No changes are proposed to 322-PU-797.
- Initial operating setpoints are provided as proposed values only and shall be reviewed by authorised Metallurgy personnel prior to implementation.
- Existing instrument bad quality, fault and communications alarms shall inhibit automatic operation. Where an instrument is used for automatic valve control, the associated valve shall automatically close.
- The intent is to implement dedicated Auto Start and Auto Stop setpoints for the new valve control functionality rather than reuse any existing LT switch points. Existing switch points and alarms would remain unchanged unless a review identifies they are already being used for the required control function.

SCADA Changes:
- Auto/Manual selection for assets indicated in PLC changes table above.
- Duty strategy selection for 322-PU-795 between the 322-PU-794 and 322-PU-796 control strategies using duty buttons (322-PU-796 was recently implemented by DDC for PCSCR-797).
- Configurable level setpoints.
- Dedicated SCADA control popups shall display the current source and destination levels, configurable start/stop level setpoints, and associated pump operating status.
- All setpoints in this PCSCR shall only be adjustable by authorised Metallurgy personnel.
[Image in form – see source document] (SCADA page extracts and conceptual mock-up agreed with Benjamin Ratcliffe from DDC – final implementation details to be determined by DDC)
fields.impact: Decant transfer pumps can run in Auto on pond levels. Operators choose which duty pump the standby 322-PU-795 backs up. Manual mode remains available.
fields.testCriteria:
- Manual start/stop of 322-PU-794/795/796
- Auto start and auto stop on level conditions
- 322-PU-795 follows selected duty strategy and valves align
- SCADA Auto/Manual, duty select and setpoints work
- Simulated bad quality on each level transmitter inhibits the affected auto strategy and closes its valve
- Return to normal after testing
